post.description: Works for users, admins and moderators. On success it sets two httpOnly, SameSite=Lax cookies (Secure when COOKIE_SECURE=true): `access_token` (JWT, JWT_ACCESS_TTL, path /api) and `refresh_token` (random, stored hashed, JWT_REFRESH_TTL, path /api/auth). No token is ever returned in the body (ACC-19); the body has the profile and `homePath`, the role's home page. Unknown email or wrong password: 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS "Invalid email or password". Suspended account (correct password): 403 ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED. ACC-05: the 5th consecutive wrong password locks the account for 15 minutes and returns 403 ACCOUNT_LOCKED with the minutes left; during the lock even the right password is refused. A successful login resets the counter. At most 5 logins of one account are checked at the same instant; extra simultaneous requests get 429 TOO_MANY_REQUESTS (no lock). In Swagger, after logging in, every "Try it out" call sends the cookie automatically.

post.description: Books one or more rooms of the same hotel for the same dates. Each room lists its adults and the age of each child (0-17); the reservation needs at least one adult, and no room may hold more guests than its maximum occupancy. Every night of every room is held together for 10 minutes (holdExpiresAt) as one PENDING_PAYMENT reservation: if any room overlaps a confirmed reservation, an unexpired hold or a blocked night, the whole request is rejected with 409 INSUFFICIENT_INVENTORY and nothing is held. The total is the sum over rooms of nights x that room's price now; the reservation keeps that price. Dates are the hotel's local dates: check-out after check-in, at most 30 nights, check-in not before today at the hotel. At most 10 rooms. An unpaid hold becomes EXPIRED and its nights are released. Amounts are minor units of the platform currency (PAY-04).

post.description: Creates a Stripe test-mode PaymentIntent for the booking's server-side total in the platform currency and returns its client secret; card details never reach this API. Requires an unexpired hold and accepted policies (PAY-02: 409 POLICIES_NOT_ACCEPTED). Asking again while a payment is open returns that same payment (also 201). 503 when Stripe is unavailable (try again); 500 when Stripe refuses the request for good (logged for the team). The booking is NOT confirmed here: only the verified Stripe webhook confirms it. In test mode, pay the returned PaymentIntent with Stripe Elements, or from the Stripe CLI: `stripe payment_intents confirm <paymentIntentId> --payment-method pm_card_visa` (pm_card_chargeDeclined to fail). Run `stripe listen --events payment_intent.succeeded,payment_intent.payment_failed,payment_intent.canceled,refund.created,refund.updated,refund.failed --forward-to localhost:3000/api/payments/webhook` (Stripe CLI 1.55+ needs --events) so the webhook confirms the booking.

post.description: Called by Stripe, not by users. The Stripe-Signature header is verified against the raw body with STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET (400 otherwise). payment_intent.succeeded confirms the booking in the same transaction that records the event, so a replay is ignored and a failure (500) is redelivered by Stripe; a payment captured after the hold expired is refunded in full. payment_intent.payment_failed records the error so the user can retry. PAY-03: refund.created, refund.updated and refund.failed settle a PENDING refund to REFUNDED or FAILED (once, with one in-app notification), matched by the Stripe refund id or metadata.refundId. Handled events: payment_intent.succeeded, payment_intent.payment_failed, payment_intent.canceled, refund.created, refund.updated, refund.failed; any other event is acknowledged and ignored.

post.description: After a failed attempt (status FAILED, lastError says why), returns the same PaymentIntent's client secret to try again. If Stripe cancelled that PaymentIntent meanwhile, the old payment is closed (CANCELED) and a NEW payment with a new id and PaymentIntent is returned: use the id in this response from now on. Refused once the hold has expired (409 HOLD_EXPIRED). 503 when Stripe is unavailable; 500 when Stripe refuses the request for good. In test mode, pay the returned PaymentIntent with Stripe Elements, or from the Stripe CLI: `stripe payment_intents confirm <paymentIntentId> --payment-method pm_card_visa` (pm_card_chargeDeclined to fail). Run `stripe listen --events payment_intent.succeeded,payment_intent.payment_failed,payment_intent.canceled,refund.created,refund.updated,refund.failed --forward-to localhost:3000/api/payments/webhook` (Stripe CLI 1.55+ needs --events) so the webhook confirms the booking.

info.title: Travel Planning & Booking Platform API
info.description:
NestJS REST API (Milestone 1). Every operation summary starts with its requirement ID from the official workbook.

* Errors always use the `ErrorResponseDto` shape; validation failures list `fieldErrors` (GEN-02).
* Lists are paginated with a fixed page size of 10; pass `page` only (GEN-05).
* Money is in integer minor units of the platform currency (PAY-04); instants are UTC ISO strings.
* Authentication uses the httpOnly `access_token` cookie set by `POST /api/auth/login` (ACC-19).

dev-user.name: x-dev-user
dev-user.description: TEMPORARY stub auth (AUTH_STUB=true, non-production, localhost only). Format ROLE, ROLE:userId or ROLE:userId:providerId (24-hex ids), e.g. ADMIN, USER, HOTEL_MODERATOR. Replaced by the access_token cookie in ACC-11.
